events.caption: Eastward push; watch the southward bend in the recorded path.

setup: Launch red east. The extra force bends its trajectory to the right.
name: Automatic side force

oracle.name: Automatic side force
oracle.law: Red and blue receive \mathbf F=1.2(v_y,-v_x,0) when |v_x|+|v_y|>0.001. This horizontal force is perpendicular to motion and points to its right, bending trajectories clockwise in top view.
oracle.condition: Red or blue is moving horizontally.
oracle.effect: A force to the right of motion turns the path clockwise.
oracle.scope: The force is perpendicular to velocity and does no work. It is not a fixed compass-direction force.

reference: Same geometry, masses and scripted actions; the altered program is disabled only in the ordinary-physics reference.
